issues: The hypotheses and plans specify different primary comparators: h1, h2 and h4 require a development-calibrated investment-matched baseline, but plans provide fixed BH10, cash and contextual BH100 only. Define the calibration formula, averaging convention, transaction costs and frozen baseline weight; time in position is not invested capital or risk matching.

h1, h3 and h4 require three new evaluation periods, whereas plans allocate development plus only two later evaluation splits. Development selection cannot also supply an untouched confirmatory fold. Reconcile fold counts, scoring windows and evaluation budgets without silently counting development as confirmation.

The plans allow two development configurations and selection of one, but the second configuration and selection objective are unspecified. Freeze both candidates, tie-breaking and all exclusions, and record this selection burden alongside the prior four configurations and 20 evaluations. SMA20/100 is a recorded retest, not a new signal family.

h4 requires variable target weights up to 0.2 and periodic resizing, but its plan specifies position_fraction 0.1 and does not define partial reductions, fractional units, cash constraints or rebalancing phase. Engine support is explicitly unverified; a generic fixed-size plan does not faithfully represent this hypothesis.

h2 does not specify which scored splits enter inference, how independent-account boundaries are handled, the bootstrap interval/test construction, or how four heterogeneous family claims supply valid p-values for Holm correction. A nominal 95% lower bound alone does not implement Holm-adjusted rejection. Block-length sensitivity and limited effective sample size also need an explicit inconclusive outcome.

The 1000-hour within-split warm-up materially shortens scoring and gives unequal scored horizons for the 180/90/90-day windows. Define benchmark entry at the same scored start, indicator initialization, account reset and final pending-order treatment. Clarify whether the 30-closed-trade requirement applies per fold, cost scenario or pooled sample; it is not a power justification and may be inappropriate for a resizing strategy.

As of 2026-10-29, much of the proposed data window is future data, while its October start is already elapsed. UNAVAILABLE_UNVERIFIED and disabled gates are appropriate, but freshness is not established by dates or absence of recorded exposure. Specify provenance, exposure checks, missing-bar rules and availability requirements before any future evaluation.

The supplied quotations literally support the two narrow mechanics cards, and evidence_quality 1 is appropriately below the ceiling of 2. They do not establish alpha or confirm the proposed execution implementation. In particular, the documented native spread treatment is not automatically equivalent to the plans' half-spread-per-side convention; pin engine/version and reconcile cost accounting without double charging. Actual slippage, impact and bid/ask data remain unavailable.
lessons_th: เอกสาร API รองรับกลไกที่อ้างตรงข้อความได้ แต่ไม่ใช่หลักฐานเชิงประจักษ์ของ alpha และ metadata ไม่ทดแทนผลการศึกษา
สมมติฐาน ฐานเทียบ จำนวนช่วงทดสอบ และแผนประเมินต้องสอดคล้องกันก่อนตีความผล โดยห้ามนับช่วงเลือกพารามิเตอร์เป็นหลักฐานยืนยันอิสระ
ความใหม่จำกัดเฉพาะประวัติที่บันทึกไว้ ส่วน SMA20/100 เป็นการทดสอบซ้ำ และคะแนน information_gain เป็นเพียงลำดับความสำคัญในการวางแผน
ข้อมูลอนาคตหรือข้อมูลที่ยังไม่ตรวจสอบต้องคงสถานะไม่พร้อมใช้ การทบทวนข้อเสนอไม่ใช่การอนุมัติออกแบบโดยมนุษย์หรืออนุญาตให้ดำเนินการ
next_questions: Which baseline-weight formula and scored-fold structure will be authoritative across the hypotheses and plans?
Will each hypothesis retain its single stated configuration, or what exactly are the second candidates and development-only selection rules?
What inferential procedure links h2's bootstrap test to the four-family Holm correction, and what outcomes will be classified as insufficient rather than failed?
How will variable weights, fractional holdings, resizing costs, warm-up boundaries and terminal marks be represented consistently in the eventual engine specification?
What evidence will establish data availability, provenance and non-exposure for each frozen evaluation window?
